utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can make Tuesday work. What time are you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: How about 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 7:30 works for me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can come, but I need to know the time and whether anyone’s bringing the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, but can you confirm what time and who’s bringing the snacks?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do it if we lock down the time and snacks first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the book club — are we meeting tonight or did that change?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think it’s tonight, unless I mixed that up again. I should probably check the note I scribbled earlier.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, probably tonight, but maybe double-check that note before we both show up at the wrong time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can swing by the book club with you.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, see you there. I’ll let you know if I hear any updates about the next one.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good, I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, did I miss anything important from the book club?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No, just the quick updates and the next book pick so far.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good. Let’s keep it simple and pick a time that works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’ll send a note to everyone and see what times work best.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, I’ll wait to see what times everyone can do and we’ll pick one from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the book club meet, and what are we reading?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: We meet Thursday evenings at 7, and this month we’re reading The House on Mango Street.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, I’ll read it and be there Thursday at 7.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I heard the book club is meeting later this week, and I can bring a few good recommendations if you want.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That sounds great, Jules. Do you know where the book club is meeting later this week?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m not sure yet, but I can ask around and let you know as soon as I hear where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That sounds lovely, Rosa. I’m in for the next book club meeting.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara. I’ll put you down for it and send over the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll look out for the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the signup sheet and the extra pens for book club.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll grab the snacks.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll bring the extra bookmarks too, just in case we need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club's picking next month's read tonight if you want to weigh in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can weigh in. What are the options?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They’re down to a few choices, and I’m hearing the short list should be ready by tonight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m happy to help with the book club, but could you tell me which book you’ve picked?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We picked The Secret Garden.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great choice. I’ll help with The Secret Garden.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can come by if you still need one more for book club.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, then we’re set. I’ll tell the others you can make it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, see you then.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, I’m in for book club. I’ll tell the others we’re set for it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks, Vik. I’ll let the others know too and I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the book club. I might’ve missed the latest update, so what’s the plan?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think it’s just the usual Thursday meeting at my place. I’ll send the time again so no one misses it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks — send it again and I’ll be there Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the book club is meeting again soon. Are we still talking about the same novel?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yes, I think so — the same one we were talking about last time.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I just wanted to make sure before I mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds lovely, Opal. I can bring the signup sheet and a few title ideas for us to pick from.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would be wonderful, Rosa. I can meet you there and help sort through the title ideas.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, then let’s meet there and narrow it down together. I’ll bring the sheet and a few strong options so we can choose quickly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can make it if we keep it simple, but I’d need the time and place nailed down first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the time and place, and keep it easy to join.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great — just send the time and place, and I’ll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the book club really starts this week, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, I think so, but let me check the details before I say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you double-check the time before we count on it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me. Let’s keep it simple and decide on a time and place for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: How about Thursday evening at my place? I can make it after 7.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thursday evening at your place works for me. After 7 is fine.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’m a little behind on the book club news too. What’s the latest everyone’s saying?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Mostly that the next pick is a mystery until someone posts the sign-up sheet, but I heard they’re leaning toward something easier this month.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the book club. I think I still have the book somewhere near the coat rack, unless I left it at home again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No rush, I can wait while you check by the coat rack. If it’s not there, I can bring my copy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, I’ll check now. If it’s not there, your copy would save me from another little hunt.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can make the book club night, but I need to work around school pickup first. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: How about 7:30? That should leave you time after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 7:30 works for me. I should be able to get there after pickup.
